create_registry: create a new Registry instance to manage SDE, Predictor, or Corrector subclasses by string key
register_class: use the register decorator to register a subclass under a unique name in the Registry
get_by_name: retrieve a registered class from the Registry by its unique string name
get_all_names: get a list of all registered names currently stored in the Registry
review_registry_class: review the Registry class and its register, get_by_name, and get_all_names methods
